findings.evidence: Invite 3 teammates this month to unlock the advanced reporting add-on.
findings.fix: Add a clickable button or link element within or adjacent to the promo box to allow users to initiate the invite flow.
findings.location: Workspace overview section, promo referral box
findings.violation: The promo message is displayed as plain text in a div with no interactive element, making it unclear if users can take action or dismiss it.

findings.fix: Add descriptive text to the button, such as "Duplicate project" or an aria-label attribute for accessibility.
findings.violation: The button has no visible text or label, leaving users unable to understand its purpose.

findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 3 projects, synced last week." followed by a list containing only "Data Warehouse Cutover" and "Mobile App Revamp"
findings.fix: Either show all 3 projects or update the text to accurately reflect the number shown, e.g., "This workspace holds 3 projects; here are your 2 most recent."
findings.violation: The text states there are 3 projects but only 2 are displayed in the recent projects list, creating confusion about the third project.

findings.fix: Replace "last week" with a specific date and time, e.g., "synced on July 28 at 2:30 PM" or show a relative time like "synced 2 hours ago".
findings.location: Workspace overview section, last sync time
findings.violation: The timestamp is vague and does not provide the exact date or time of the last sync, making it difficult for users to know how current the data is.

findings.evidence: "An invite was sent to the address entered above. It expires in 5 days if not accepted."
findings.fix: Add a "Resend invite" button or link below the message to allow users to send a new invitation if needed.
findings.violation: The message informs users of the expiration but offers no way to resend the invite or check its status if the recipient does not respond.

findings.evidence: "The last import finished with 2 rows skipped: each referenced a project that does not exist in this workspace. Rows 15 and 99 were skipped; every other row was imported."
findings.fix: Add the total row count to the message, e.g., "The last import processed 150 rows; 2 were skipped (rows 15 and 99)."
findings.violation: The message specifies which rows were skipped but does not state the total number of rows processed, making it hard to assess the scale of the import.
